subject: E-Commerce
title: Sneak Into Cart
description: A 60-second lesson on Sneak Into Cart.

hook.text: You buy one item and find insurance, gift wrapping, and a warranty pre-added to your cart. You didn't ask for them.

buildup.text: Sneak-into-cart adds items during checkout that require active removal. Most people don't notice.

discovery.text: Airlines pioneered this: seat upgrades, travel insurance, and baggage pre-selected at checkout.

twist.text: GoDaddy was infamous for adding privacy protection, email, and hosting to domain purchases. Revenue soared.

climax.text: The EU banned pre-ticked boxes in 2014. The US still allows most sneak-into-cart practices.

punchline.text: Items you never wanted, pre-added at checkout. Sneak-into-cart erodes trust.

quiz.question: What is the 'sneak into cart' dark pattern?
options: Pre-adding items to your cart that you didn't request
